note: The voice runner's tuning — every number the table's talk runs on that is not an operator's choice. Until 2026-09-16 each of these was an ARENA_* environment knob (hardening plan §2: 36 knobs on the voice path, only ARENA_CHATTER was ever set); they live here now, as data, documented once. The operator keeps five knobs: ARENA_CHATTER (the one dial — it scales min_gap_s, barks_cooldown_s, barks_swing, barks_hit and patter_gap_s at start-up and spends the talk budget it derives from DUTY_BASE at roll time), ARENA_BARKS (off | some | all), ARENA_VOICE_YOUR_MOVE (on | some | off), ARENA_VOICE_SFX and ARENA_VOICE_FOCUS; Joshua's render settings (ARENA_VOICE_ID / MODEL / FORMAT / MAX_CHARS / FX / GLITCH) and the launch plumbing (ARENA_HUMAN_DECK, ARENA_SEAT_DECKS) are not tuning. Read once by voice.table.load_tuning() into VoiceRunner (runner/voice_runner.py) and ChainTable (runner/chains.py); a test may pass VoiceRunner(tuning={...}) to override a value. Times are seconds; *_p are probabilities; a null duty_target means derived from the dial. tests/test_tuning.py holds every key to exactly one attribute.
